about: Every remark the coach makes in plain words, in one place. Edit the lines, keep the keys. Rage mode lines: the coach picks one line per move from the matching situation (checked top to bottom, the first match wins); several lines give variety. Keep rage lines about the play, never about the person. Tips: the one-line advice next to each habit on the profile and in the recap. Lines with numbers (the move cards' reasons, the coach's notes) are built from the match data in code and aren't here.

lines: K, didn't care about your teammate. Good job.

summary.untradedDeaths: You keep dying where nobody can trade you. Play WITH your team, for fuck's sake.
summary.isolatedDeaths: Stop running off alone. Every time you go solo, you die solo.
summary.openingDeaths: You give away the first kill every other round. Stop being the free opening.
summary.whiffs: You miss sprays you should hit. Stop, aim, then shoot.
summary.unusedUtil: You die with your grenades every round. THROW THEM.
summary.wastedFlashes: Your flashes blind nobody. Learn one good flash per spot.
summary.teamHarm: You hurt your own team more than the enemy does. Call your utility.
summary.awpLost: You keep losing the AWP. That's $4,750 a pop. Play it safer.
summary.lowHpFights: You take fights on low HP like you're immortal. You're not.
summary.adr: Your damage is a joke. Get into fights that matter.
summary.kast: Half the rounds you did nothing. Be useful.
summary.hs: Aim at the head. That round thing on top.
summary.trades: Your teammates die and you don't trade. Swing!
summary.impact: You barely change rounds. Kills that matter, please.
summary.side: One side you play fine, the other you throw. Fix it.
summary.none: Honestly? Not bad. Don't make me say it twice.

tips.untradedDeaths: Fight where a teammate can trade you: push with someone a step behind, or from a spot a teammate sees.
tips.isolatedDeaths: When you push alone and it fails, nobody can trade. Keep the aggression, but take it where a teammate can follow.
tips.openingDeaths: The first death of the round costs most: take the first fight with a flash, or let the entry go first.
tips.whiffs: Sprays that miss: stop before shooting, burst at range, and reset instead of spraying on the move.
tips.unusedUtil: You die with grenades in your pocket: throw something into a fight you're about to take.
tips.wastedFlashes: Flashes that blind nobody: pop them over the angle you're about to peek, for yourself or called for a teammate.
tips.teamHarm: Your utility hurts teammates: call your flashes, and throw them where your team isn't looking.
tips.awpLost: You lose the AWP often: after a shot, move back instead of re-peeking the same angle.
tips.lowHpFights: You take fights already hurt: reset, wait for the trade, or play for information.
tips.adr: Damage per round: get into more fights that matter, with utility first.
tips.kast: Rounds where you did something (kill, assist, survive, traded): stay alive and tradeable.
tips.hs: Headshots: keep your crosshair at head height while moving, and stop before the shot.
tips.utilDamage: Grenade damage: HEs and mollies on spots enemies hold or cross (they also soften fights).
tips.flashAssists: Flashes that win fights: flash for a teammate's peek, not only for your own.
tips.trades: Trading teammates: stay close enough to swing when one dies; the window is about 2 s.
tips.impact: Win chance you add per round: plays that change rounds, not just kills.
tips.loud: You run near enemies: shift-walk within about 20 m of where an enemy could be. They hear you coming.
tips.react: Reaction: hold angles you expect them on, crosshair already there, so you react instead of searching.
tips.aim: Crosshair placement: pre-aim where heads appear (corners, boxes) while you move.
tips.stopped: Counter-strafe: stop (tap the opposite key) before the first shot.
